title: Enhancing recall in asphalt pavement crack segmentation using a HoughNet-extended U-Net architecture with reconstruction head
mechanism: Voting-based (HoughNet) segmentation head plus a reconstruction head to raise crack recall at similar precision.
adaptation: Swap the crack logit for a log-polar voting head; aimed at relR@2 toward the 0.90 target.
min_experiment: Arm = PF + voting crack head; baseline = PF; 5 seeds; relR@2 at relP@2 >= 0.90. Kill if relR@2 gain < 0.01.
evidence: R: Crack500 higher recall at similar precision; GAPS384 thin cracks best F1.
